scripts.build: npm --prefix prototype install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix prototype run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const out='.next';if(fs.existsSync(out))fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('prototype/.next',out,{recursive:true,force:true});const src=path.join(out,'routes-manifest.json');const dst=path.join(out,'routes-manifest-deterministic.json');if(fs.existsSync(src)&&!fs.existsSync(dst))fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);"
